setName: 2025 Topps Series 1 + Series 2 Baseball -- named insert/autograph/relic sets
mintedBy: Acquisition follow-up (2026-09-21) to R40/#2373-#2376: those PRs staged the BASE ladder only and explicitly flagged named insert/auto/relic sets as out of scope for a follow-up (see 2025-topps-series2-baseball.manifest.json notMinted.insertSets). Diagnosed against a read-only sold_comps sample (baseball/2025/topps, 300 sales, id-prefix hiq:baseball:2025:topps:): of 52 distinct unbacked ids, 50 pointread as genuinely absent (2 were a printRun-suffix mismatch, not a checklist gap) and the majority named exactly these 8 insert/auto/relic sets by cardNumber prefix (BSA/BSA2, CC/CC2, CCAR/CCA2, SMLB, PPA).

sectionsIncluded.note: The Series 2 page states ONE set of 105 cards under this heading but the source itself mixes two code shapes: BSA2-xx for new S2-only players and BSA-xx (bare) for players repeating a Series 1 BSA code. Both shapes verified as part of the SAME stated 105-card roster (counted directly off the page: 80 BSA2- rows + 25 BSA- rows immediately following, ending exactly at the next section marker 'Baseball Stars Dual Autographs'). Included in the SAME category as the Series 1 BSA rows above; cardNumber is the source's own code in each case, so no BSA- vs BSA2- collision is possible (they are disjoint by construction -- the 25 trailing BSA- codes here are checked against the 102 Series-1 BSA- codes and do not overlap).

Distinct from 2023's 'Postseason Performance Autograph Relics' package already in the repo (a relic product, different name and ladder) -- this 2025 set is stated as 'Postseason Performance Autographs' (no Relics in the name) with its own smaller ladder; category named accordingly, no spelling collision.

rowCount_check: 2,622 rows total: BSA-S1(102x6=612) + SMLB(30x5=150) + CC(36x6=216) + CCAR(24x5=120) -- these four SKIP their blank-parallel base row because it is already staged and merged in acq-2026-09-20-beckett-topps-series1-2025-baseball/2025-topps-series1-baseball.csv (verified: exact grep-count match, 102/30/36/24 rows respectively, category+cardNumber identical) -- + BSA2(105x7=735) + CC2(47x7=329) + CCA2(35x6=210) + PPA(50x5=250), which DO include their base row because neither exists anywhere else in the repo (verified: 0 hits for these 4 categories in the Series 2 base file and repo-wide grep). This package is additive-only: it never re-stages a row another already-merged package already carries.

otherSeries1And2InsertSets.reason: All fully readable on the same two source pages (verified present with card-by-card rosters and verbatim parallel ladders during this diagnosis) but NOT staged in this package -- kept to the highest-confidence, highest-sales-impact subset (BSA/BSA2, CC/CC2, CCAR/CCA2, SMLB, PPA) that this diagnosis directly measured as unbacked in the sold_comps sample. Candidates for a follow-up package; sources already confirmed reachable and well-structured.

spellingAudit: category names follow the repo's existing convention exactly (auto-baseball-stars-autographs, auto-postseason-performance-autographs match the spelling already used in acq-2026-09-20-beckett-topps-series1-2023-baseball's own CSV, cross-checked by direct grep before naming these). Parallel names (Blue/Gold/Orange/Black/Red/Platinum/FoilFractor/Gold Foilboard/etc.) are the source's own words verbatim, no reformatting beyond stripping the 'or less' odds qualifier from the printRun-bearing cell into a note (printRun value itself is the stated ceiling, e.g. Blue /150 or less -> printRun 150).
selectCardsOnlyAudit: No 'select cards only' language found in any of the 8 sections' own Parallels sentences; each ladder is stated to apply to the full named roster (102/105/30/36/24/47/35/50 cards respectively), not a named subset.
